original_source_statement_tex:
\label{lemma-blowup-fitting-ideal}
Let $R$ be a ring. Let $M$ be a finite $R$-module.
Let $k \geq 0$ and $I = \text{Fit}_k(M)$. For every $a \in I$
with $R' = R[\frac{I}{a}]$ the strict transform
$$
M' = (M \otimes_R R')/a\text{-power torsion}
$$
has $\text{Fit}_k(M') = R'$.
stage_b_review_note: Pinned lemma 6173 assumes M finite and I=Fit_k(M), and asserts for each a∈I the strict transform modulo a-power torsion on the affine blowup chart R[I/a] has k-th Fitting ideal equal to the whole ring. Stage A keeps the chart, torsion quotient and quantifier on a.

original_source_statement_tex:
\label{lemma-blowup-fitting-ideal-locally-free}
Let $R$ be a ring. Let $M$ be a finite $R$-module.
Let $k \geq 0$ and $I = \text{Fit}_k(M)$. Assume that
$M_\mathfrak p$ is free of rank $k$ for every
$\mathfrak p \not \in V(I)$. Then for every $a \in I$
with $R' = R[\frac{I}{a}]$ the strict transform
$$
M' = (M \otimes_R R')/a\text{-power torsion}
$$
is locally free of rank $k$.
stage_b_review_note: Pinned lemma 6197 additionally assumes M_p free of rank k for each p outside V(Fit_k(M)) and concludes the same chartwise strict transform is locally free of rank k. The draft retains this open-locus hypothesis.

original_source_statement_tex:
\label{lemma-blowup-module}
Let $R$ be a ring. Let $M$ be a finite $R$-module. Let $f \in R$
be an element such that $M_f$ is finite locally free of rank $r$.
Then there exists a finitely generated ideal $I \subset R$ with
$V(f) = V(I)$ such that for all $a \in I$ with $R' = R[\frac{I}{a}]$
the strict transform
$$
M' = (M \otimes_R R')/a\text{-power torsion}
$$
is locally free of rank $r$.
stage_b_review_note: Pinned lemma 6228 assumes finite M over R and existence of f with M_f finite locally free of rank r, and constructs a finitely generated I with V(I)=V(f) so every affine blowup chart strict transform has rank-r local freeness. The statement retains existence and universal a∈I quantifiers.
